question: What is the selective agar of choice for the isolation of the Genus Bordetella ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Bordetella species are fastidious organisms. -> Fastidious organisms require specific nutrients and environmental conditions for growth. -> Selective agar is designed to support the growth of specific organisms while inhibiting others. -> Regan-Lowe agar is the selective agar of choice for the isolation of the Genus Bordetella. -> 95%

CHAIN: Bordetella pertussis is a Gram-negative bacterium. -> Selective agar for Bordetella species should inhibit the growth of other bacteria. -> Regan-Lowe agar contains antibiotics that suppress the growth of unwanted organisms. -> Regan-Lowe agar is the selective agar of choice for the isolation of the Genus Bordetella. -> 90%
analysis: Bordetella species are best isolated using Regan-Lowe agar, which contains charcoal and cephalexin to inhibit the growth of other bacteria and fungi.
